data.body: Correction to the landing comment's node-count sentence: the default selection fell 20026 -> 19816 collected nodes (-210) between 5ad259f2c75 and this change on this host; the story's own reconciliation is 464 before = 147 kept + 43 moved + 274 deleted. Post-merge re-run of the 19 destinations + kept files on 441ca94f4a8 in one serial process showed 3 extra failures in test_fetcher_split_jql_queries.py; root-caused as a pre-existing order-dependent sys.path leak (reproduces identically on 5ad259f2c75, i.e. not caused by this story), filed as evolvable-sooty-okapi (0796-3fa4) with the minimal reproduction.
